latestVersion.changelog:
Adaptive RAG Engine v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end adaptive retrieval engine moving from linear search to autonomous cognitive loops.
- Integrates capsule pre-filtering, adaptive search routing, CRAG error correction/evaluation, and L3 output verification.
- Features vector search (bge-m3), semantic re-ranking, and active memory bridge integration.
- Provides protocol-driven workflows with automated module triggering for complex queries and memory retrieval.
- Includes scripts to rebuild capsule index and evaluate retrieval quality.
- Clarifies relationships with phoenix-memory (storage) and dynamic-rag-capsule (compression), positioning this skill as the strategy/controller.
